objective: Computation. Attach the Fano plane at a point of large plane pieces, ladders (prisms over even cycles) and grids (duals of subdivided octahedra, to 256 points); compute every gluing line's transfer by heights and apply the route criterion at every removal inside the handle and four far sides; cross-check the pipeline against exact creation on small spaces; map the halo by distance and measure how the reach grows with size.
status: Proved by HALO-FORCING-20261103-001C-P001 (computation with a pipeline validated on 2,784 exact cases): an opened Fano handle attached at a point creates along the whole of a ladder (prisms to 80 points: reach equal to the farthest gluing line, two of four lines at each distance) but only out to distance 3 on grids (subdivided-octahedron duals to 256 points). Fixing the split point's copies leaves every ladder line with two patterns at any distance, while every grid line at distance 7 or more is exactly independent of the split point: frozen against liquid forcing
title: The reach on ladders and grids
